metadata.title: Sharp Bounds for Nodal Sets of Steklov Eigenfunctions on Smooth Surfaces
metadata.abstract: We prove a sharp linear upper bound for the interior nodal length of Steklov eigenfunctions on smooth compact Riemannian surfaces with boundary, establishing the upper bound predicted by the Steklov analogue of Yau's conjecture in dimension two. On each fixed surface, we also show that the nodal length divided by the logarithm of the eigenvalue tends to infinity, uniformly over the eigenfunctions. We construct examples to show this divergence can be arbitrarily slow. These examples rule out every general lower bound by a positive power of the eigenvalue, in contrast with the linear lower bound on analytic surfaces by Polterovich-Sher-Toth. Moreover, boundary zero counts and both interior and boundary nodal domain counts satisfy sharp linear bounds for large eigenvalues. We also prove density estimates for boundary zeros on at least one boundary component and construct a fixed analytic cylinder on which another component remains free of boundary zeros along an unbounded sequence of eigenvalues.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 光滑 Steklov 节集的锐界
analysis.workSummary: 对光滑紧带边黎曼曲面证明内部节线长度的线性特征值上界，并给出比对数更快但可任意慢的统一下界增长，排除一般正幂下界；同时处理边界零点和节域计数。
analysis.breakthrough: 区分光滑与解析情形：上界保持线性，下界可远弱于解析曲面的线性规律。
analysis.limitations: 下界是固定曲面上节长除以特征值对数趋于无穷，不是统一于所有曲面的定量速度。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者称数学内容和写作由本人完成，但 ChatGPT 在编辑过程中协助发现数学与排印错误；这些检查用途仍属正面披露。文献中的 OpenAI 预印本引用不是独立协作证据。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28391v1 · 第26页 Declaration of AI use
